interactables.title: CUSTOMS
interactables.text:
CUSTOMS

interactables.prompt: Follow the Road Back to the Old Road

interactables.title: The Dry Fountain
interactables.text:
The fountain is dry. Carved round its rim, worn almost smooth, are the words: 'WELCOME TO ' and then a long gouge where a name used to be, as if something bit it out of the stone.

Someone has chalked underneath, in big wobbly letters: 'BUTT-BUTT WOZ ERE'.

interactables.title: The Midnight Market
interactables.text:
THE MIDNIGHT MARKET
Open from Midnight until Two
(Closed at all other times, including yesterday)

Today's Specials:
- Yesterdays (slightly used)
- Lost Umbrellas (all colours, all owners)
- One (1) Tuesday
- Names (NOT FOR SALE. Do not ask.)

interactables.prompt: Read the Chalk on the Wall
interactables.title: Chalked Verse (One)
interactables.text:
In a child's chalk, big and careful, only legible by moonlight:

'OUR TOWN IS BY THE BENDING RIVER,
OUR BREAD IS WARM, OUR BELLS ARE SILVER...'

(and a drawing of a bell with a face)

interactables.prompt: Read the Chalk on the Wall
interactables.title: Chalked Verse (Two)
interactables.text:
'...WE NEVER LOCK OUR DOORS AT NIGHT,
WE SING OUR NAME TO KEEP IT RIGHT...'

(and a drawing of a door, open, with a smiley sun)

interactables.prompt: Read the Chalk on the Wall
interactables.title: Chalked Verse (Three)
interactables.text:
'...AND IF YOU FORGET, THE BELL WILL TELL:
WE ARE ...'

The last word has been rubbed out, hard, by something that wasn't a hand. Underneath, the same child has written: 'I DIDN'T DO THAT. - BUTT-BUTT'.

interactables.title: From the Bell Tower
interactables.text:
You lean on the parapet. Under the moon, the streets of Here spread out below you, and for the first time you see their shape: not a grid, not a tangle, but letters. The streets spell something, the way a river spells a valley.

You trace it with your finger, street by street, and hold it in your head before it can slip away.

The Cartographer will want to hear about this.

interactables.title: The Archive
interactables.text:
THE ARCHIVE OF [CITY NAME HERE]
Wherein Is Kept the Name

The brass where the name should be is chewed, like a pencil end.
